questions.prompt: — Could you please tell me ________? — Certainly, it is used for serving really cold ice-cream.
options: A. what was the hot ice-cream scoop used for
B. how the hot ice-cream scoop was used for
C. what the hot ice-cream scoop is used for
questions.analysis: 【详解】句意：——你能告诉我热的冰淇淋勺是用来做什么的吗？——当然，它是用来提供非常冷的冰淇淋的。考查宾语从句。宾语从句陈述语序，先排除A，结合答语“ it is used for serving really cold ice-cream.”，可知是询问热冰淇淋勺的用途，用what。故选C。

questions.prompt: —As a panda lover, you’ve mentioned Tuan Tuan and Yuan Yuan to me several times. So can you tell me ________? —Sure. At a zoo in China.
options: A. where they will be born
B. where they were born
C. where were they born
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——作为一个熊猫爱好者，你多次向我提到团团和圆圆。你能告诉我他们在哪里出生吗？——当然可知。在中国的一个动物园里。
考查宾语从句及动词的时态。根据“So can you tell me…”可知，此处为宾语从句，应该用陈述语序，故排除C项。结合选项可知，此处询问熊猫出生的时间，应该为过去时态。故选B。

questions.prompt: —I wonder ________ you are collecting old books at school. —Because we want to give them away to children in mountainous areas.
options: A. how
B. why
C. when
D. whether
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——我想知道你为什么在学校收集旧书。——因为我们想把它们送给山区的孩子们。
考查宾语从句连接词。how如何；why为什么；when什么时候；whether是否。根据“Because we want to give them away to children in mountainous areas.”可知是询问原因，应用why。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Excuse me. Could you please tell me ________? — Well, come to ask Mr. Lee for the key.
options: A. how I can enter the reading room
B. when the reading room is open
C. why the reading room is closed
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——打扰一下，你能告诉我怎样才能进入阅览室吗？——好，去问李先生拿钥匙。
考查宾语从句。根据“come to ask Mr. Lee for the key”可知，对方询问的是某种方式方法，宾语从句连接词需用how。选项A“如何进入阅览室”符合语境。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What did your parents say to you just now? —They asked me ________.
options: A. why did I look unhappy then
B. where I will spend my summer holiday
C. if I enjoyed myself at the party
D. when did I attend the graduation party
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——你父母刚才对你说了什么？——他们问我在聚会上是否玩得开心。
考查宾语从句。根据“They asked me…”可知本句是宾语从句。宾语从句应用陈述句语序，AD选项是疑问句语序，排除；主句是一般过去时，则从句也应是过去的某种时态，B选项是一般将来时，排除。故选C。

questions.prompt: Could you tell me ________?
options: A. what is the matter with her
B. what the matter is with her
C. what the matter was with her
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：你能告诉我她怎么了吗？
考查宾语从句。根据“Could you tell me”及选项可知，句子考查宾语从句的语序，What’s the matter with...?这样的句型本身就是陈述语序，what是从句的主语，也是从句引导词。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me ________? —Certainly. He’s a driver.
options: A. what does he do
B. what he does
C. how he does
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——你能告诉我他的职业是什么吗？——当然。他是一名司机。
考查宾语从句。根据答句“He’s a driver.”可知，问句询问他的职业是什么，可用“What does he do?”来询问他的职业是什么，但是此处为宾语从句，宾语从句的语序为陈述句语序，所以what he does符合。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me ________? —With pleasure. Wait a moment, please.
options: A. if the scarf looked nice on me
B. what is the now product like
C. how I can order a robot online
D. who did you meet
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——请问你能告诉我怎么在网上订购机器人吗？——我很乐意。请稍等。

C. so
D. if

【详解】句意：虽然我爷爷已经八十岁了，但他每天都坚持锻炼。
考查连词词义辨析。/不填；but但是，并列连词，表示转折关系；so因此，并列连词，表示因果关系；if是否，如果，引导宾语从句或条件状语从句。结合句意可知，前后句存在让步关系。前半句有单词“Though虽然”，所以后半句不能出现but。“Though”和“but”不能同时出现。故选A。

questions.prompt: —I’m wondering ________ at a low price. —You can book one through our official APP.
options: A. how I can buy the air ticket
B. how can I buy the air ticket
C. when I can buy the air ticket
D. when can I buy the air ticket
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——我想知道什么时候能买到便宜的机票。——您可以通过我们的官方APP预订。
考查宾语从句。根据“I’m wondering”可知，句子含宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，排除B和D；答句是订机票的方式，用how提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Sarah, do you know ________? —It’s on April 23.
options: A. what is World Book Day
B. what World Book Day is
C. when is World Book Day
D. when World Book Day is
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——萨拉，你知道世界读书日是在什么时候吗？——在4月23日。
考查when引导的宾语从句。宾语从句应用陈述语序，故排除A、C。what World Book Day is什么是世界读书日；when World Book Day is世界读书日是在什么时候。根据答句“It’s on April 23.”可知此处应是when引导的宾语从句，询问时间。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Mum, I found a wallet on the bus this morning. — I think you should give it to the police and they may know ________.
options: A. how is the owner
B. who is the owner
C. how the owner is
D. who the owner is
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——妈妈。今天早上我在公共汽车上发现了一个钱包。——我想你应该把它交给警察，他们也许会知道主人是谁。
考查宾语从句。此处是宾语从句，需用陈述语序，排除AB；结合“I think you should give it to the police and they may know...”可知，是可能知道主人是谁。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me ________? —Never spend too much time on screen.
options: A. how we can have bright eyes
B. why we should protect our eyes
C. where we can see an eye doctor
D. when we should do eye exercises
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——你能告诉我怎样才能拥有明亮的眼睛吗？——不要花太多时间在屏幕上。
考查宾语从句的引导词。how如何，怎样；why为什么；where哪里；when什么时候。根据“Never spend too much time on screen”可推测出，在询问如何才能拥有明亮的眼镜，“如何，怎样”，此时应用关系副词how引导宾语从句。故选A。

B. what my classmates call me
C. why do my classmates call me

questions.prompt: The chief engineer announced that they ________ a space lab on the space station around the end of 2022.
options: A. have built
B. had built
C. will build
D. would build
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：总工程师宣布，他们将于2022年底左右在空间站建造一个空间实验室。
考查动词时态。根据“The chief engineer announced that”可知，that后为宾语从句，主句为一般过去时，从句为过去的某种时态，结合从句时间状语“around the end of 2022”可知，此处使用过去将来时，would+动词原形。故选D。

options: A. what it was going to discover
B. why was it sent there
C. what it looks like
D. how many photos does it take there
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：2021年5月15日，中国的天问一号探测器登陆火星。你知道那是什么样子吗。

questions.prompt: — Jim is planning a trip to Shanghai this weekend, but still doesn’t decide________. —Why not take the high-speed railway? It’s fast and comfortable.
options: A. who will he visit
B. what he will do
C. how he’s going there
D. whom is he going with
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——吉姆计划这个周末去上海旅行，但还没决定怎么去那里。——为什么不坐高铁呢？又快又舒服。
考查宾语从句。从句是宾语从句，用陈述语序，排除A和D选项。根据答语“Why not take the high-speed railway”可知，是还没有决定出行的方式，用how引导宾语从句，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Look! The building over there is our newly built school library. —It’s so beautiful! Could you please tell me ________?
options: A. that you entered the library before
B. when it is going to be open to students
C. whether can I borrow books from it now
D. how much we needed to pay for each book
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——看！那边的大楼是我们新建的学校图书馆。——太漂亮了！你能告诉我它什么时候会对学生开放吗？
考查when引导的宾语从句。that you entered the library before你之前进去过图书馆；when it is going to be open to students它什么时候会对学生开放；whether can I borrow books from it now表达错误，从句应用陈述语序；how much we needed to pay for each book每本书我们需要支付多少钱。根据“tell me”可知后接宾语从句，从句应用陈述语序，根据“Could you please tell me”可知从句应用疑问句来进行提问，根据“The building over there is our newly built school library.”可知，图书馆是借书的地方，不需要付钱，因此选项B“它什么时候会对学生开放”符合语境。故选B。

D. who did you meet
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——请问你能告诉我怎么在网上订购机器人吗？——我很乐意。请稍等。
考查宾语从句。根据“Could you please tell me”可知，空格处是宾语从句，宾语从句应为陈述语序，故排除选项B和D。结合语境和“Could you please...”可知，此处could表委婉语气，不表过去时态，A选项不应该用一般过去时态。故选C。

questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：——我想知道他是否会来参加我的生日聚会。——别担心，如果他来了，我会让你知道的。
考查if引导的从句的时态。第一空考查if引导的宾语从句，不知道他是否会来，动作发生在将来，应为一般将来时。第二空考查if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，从句应为一般现在时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Though my grandpa is eighty years old, he keeps exercising every day.
options: B. but
C. so
D. if
questions.analysis:
【详解】句意：虽然我爷爷已经八十岁了，但他每天都坚持锻炼。
考查连词词义辨析。/不填；but但是，并列连词，表示转折关系；so因此，并列连词，表示因果关系；if是否，如果，引导宾语从句或条件状语从句。结合句意可知，前后句存在让步关系。前半句有单词“Though虽然”，所以后半句不能出现but。“Though”和“but”不能同时出现。故选A。

考查定语从句。when关系副词，指时间；which关系代词，指物；whom关系代词，指人；whose关系代词，指“……的”。根据“the day”和“we Chinese people will never forget”可知，the day为先行词在从句中作宾语，因此用关系代词which引导宾语从句。故选B。

【详解】句意：很高兴知道我们不在的时候，住在动物中心的狗会得到很好的照顾。
考查宾语从句引导词和定语动词关系代词。根据“... live in the animal centre”可知，第二空为定语从句引导词，修饰先行词the dogs，先行词是物，从句缺主语，关系代词用which或that。根据“... the dogs ... will be well cared for while we are away.”可知，第一空是宾语从句引导词，意思是“狗会得到很好的照顾”，由句意可知不存在疑问的含义，所以引导词用that。故选D。

考查定语从句和宾语从句。what“什么”；which“哪一个”。空一为定语从句，先行词“her words”指物，故关系词用which；再根据“realize”为动词，故判断“...silly mistakes I had made”为宾语从句，连接词应用what，在宾语从句中作“made”的宾语。故选B。

questions.prompt: Here I go!” The second one said, “Well, I think I can do that, ______ ____ ______ .
options: A. also
B. too
C. either
questions.analysis:
句意：嗯，我想我也能做到。
also也；too也；either或者。根据下文“Here I go”可知，另一滴雨滴认为自己也能做到，故空格处应填意为“也”的单词，且空格处位于句末，故应填too。故选B。

questions.prompt: So what good is it for me to read?” The grandfather ______ ____ ______ turned from putting coal in the stove and replied, “Take this coal basket down to the river and bring ______ 35 ______ back a basket of water.” The boy did ______ 36 ______ his grandpa said, but all the water leaked (漏) out before he got back home.
options: A. quiet
B. quieter
C. quietly
questions.analysis:
句意：爷爷平静地转身把煤放进炉子里并回答说。
quiet平静的，形容词；quieter更平静的，形容词比较级；quietly平静地，副词。此处修饰动词turned应用副词。故选C。

questions.prompt: —As is known to all, the 2022 Winter Olympics is coming. Can you tell me ________ it is held? —Every four years.
options: A. how long
B. how often
C. how soon
questions.analysis: 句意：——众所周知，2022年冬季奥运会即将到来。你能告诉我它多久举办一次吗？——每四年一次。考查疑问副词。how long多长，对长度或一段时间进行提问；how often多久一次，对频率进行提问；how soon多久以后，对将来的时间进行提问。根据“Every four years”可知，询问的是举办奥运会的频率。故选B。

questions.prompt: He asked to have a thick cloth ______ ____ ______ can be put up between the two walls so that neither of them could see each other.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whom
D. whose
questions.analysis:
句意：他要求在两堵墙之间铺一块厚布，这样他们就看不见对方了。
who谁；which哪个；whom谁，who的宾格；whose谁的。此处是定语从句，先行词是物，空处在句中作主语，用which引导。故选B。

when什么时候；where在哪里；how如何；why为什么。根据“he wondered...he had made it.”可知是指想知道如何做到的。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me. I wonder ________. —It should be classified (分类) first and thrown into different bins.
options: A. where can I throw the rubbish
B. how I deal with the rubbish
C. what should I do with the rubbish
D. when should I throw the rubbish
questions.analysis:
句意：——对不起。我想知道我该如何处理垃圾。——应该先分类，然后再扔进不同的垃圾桶。
考查宾语从句的语序。根据下文“It should be classified (分类) first and thrown into different bins.”可知，应是问如何处理垃圾；宾语从句中应用陈述句语序，排除选项A、C和D。故选B。

questions.prompt: You never know ________ the Spirit of Lei Feng can go. You don’t know who it can influence, either.
options: A. how long

D. how often
questions.analysis:
句意：你永远不知道雷锋精神能走多远。你也不知道它能影响到谁。
考查特殊疑问词。how long多久；how far多远；how soon多久以后；how often多久一次。根据“the Spirit of Lei Feng can go”可知，此处应该表示提问距离，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Your written English is really perfect. Could you tell me _______? —Of course. You can keep a diary in English as often as possible.
options: A. why I can improve my written English
B. why can I improve my written English
C. how I can improve my written English
D. how can I improve my written English
questions.analysis:
句意：——你的英语写作真的很完美。你能告诉我如何提高我的英语写作水平吗？——当然。你可以尽可能多地用英语写日记。
考查宾语从句。根据空前的“Could you tell me…”及选项可知此处是宾语从句，宾语从句要用陈述语序，排除选项B和D；由答语“You can keep a diary in English as often as possible.”可知应询问提高英语写作水平的方式，用how引导。故选C。

C. how I can get some flowers
D. how can I get some flowers

考查宾语从句。由答语“ Go to the second floor. There’s a bookstore between the bank and the supermarket”知，此句是问地点，排除C、项；且宾语从句用陈述语序，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Paul, do you know _________? An engineer. —That’s cool. I guess you often fix things for others in your school.
options: A. who comes to my school
B. where we went today
C. what my classmates call me
D. why I spoke to the old
questions.analysis:
句意：——保罗，你知道我的同学叫我什么吗？一名工程师。——很酷。我猜你在学校经常帮别人修东西。
考查宾语从句。who comes to my school谁来我的学校了；where we went today我们今天去哪里；what my classmates call me我的同学都称我为什么；why I spoke to the old我为什么要和老人说话；根据“An engineer”和“I guess you often fix things for others in your school.”可知，此处表示同学们称我为什么，故选C。

questions.prompt: The survey on the children ________ that more than five sixths of them ________ interested in science books because they seems a little boring.
options: A. show; is
B. shows; are
C. shows; is
D. show; are
questions.analysis: 句意：对孩子们的调查显示，超过六分之五的孩子对科学书籍感兴趣，因为它们看起来有点无聊。考查主谓一致。第一空句子主语是The survey，是单数名词，所以动词用三单形式；而第二空主语是含有分数的结构，谓语动词由分数后面的them决定，所以应该用复数形式，也就是be动词要用are，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tony, could you tell me ________ in a short time? —By reading English as much as possible.
options: A. how can I improve my English
B. how I can improve my English
C. how could I improve my English
D. how I could improve my English
questions.analysis:
句意：——托尼，你能告诉我怎么样在短时间里提高我的英语吗？——通过尽可能多的阅读英语。
考查宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除AC选项；根据“could you tell me”可知，这里表示的是委婉语气，时态是一般现在时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —She seemed to be suddenly filled with _______ and lifted two kids together from the water. —Don’t forget that she’s a mom. Every mom will be a fighter when their kids are in danger.
options: A. ability
B. energy
C. patience
D. confidence
questions.analysis:
——她似乎突然充满了能量，把两个孩子一起从水中抱了起来。——别忘了她是个妈妈。当孩子处于危险之中时，每个妈妈都会成为一名战士。
考查名词辨析。ability能力；energy能量；patience耐心；confidence自信。由“lifted two kids together from the water”可知，此处是指充满了能量。故选B。

questions.prompt: —My parents always like to listen to old songs. —I think that can ________ their feelings and experiences when they were young.
options: A. call up
B. come through
C. give out
D. take on
questions.analysis:
句意：——我父母总是喜欢听老歌。——我觉得那可以唤起他们年轻时候的感受和经历。
考查动词短语。call up唤起；come through穿过；give out分发；take on承担。根据“their feelings and experiences”可知是唤起他们的感受和经历，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Miss Yang, do you think I can realize my dream? —Sure. You’ll always have the ________ to be successful if you keep working on it.
options: A. chance
B. result
C. need

questions.analysis: 句意：——杨小姐，你认为我能实现我的梦想吗?——当然。如果你坚持努力，你永远有机会成功。 考查名词辨析。chance机会；result结果；need需要；action行动；根据“to be successful if you keep working on it.”可知，如果坚持的话，是有机会成功的，故选A。

questions.prompt: —I wonder _________ they collect old books at school. —They want to give away these books to the poor children in the Daliang Mountains of Sichuan Province.
options: A. how
B. why
C. if
questions.analysis:
句意：——我想知道他们为什么在学校收集旧书。——他们想把这些书送给四川大凉山的贫困儿童。
考查宾语从句。how怎样；why为什么；if如果，是否。根据“They want to give away these books”可知，询问收集旧书的原因，用why引导宾语从句，故选B。

考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，此处是宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，排除A选项。结合答语“She is from Canada”可知，询问来自哪里，用where询问。故选B。

source.analysisFile: 宾语从句.md

questions.prompt: I just came back from Shanghai Disneyland. Can you guess ______ ? —I’ve no idea. But it can’t be cheap. I’ve heard everything is very expensive there.
options: A. how I came back home
B. how many days I stayed there
C. how much I paid for the Mickey Mouse toy
questions.analysis: 句意:——我刚从上海迪士尼乐园回来。你能猜出来我买的这个米老鼠玩具花了多少钱吗?——不知道。但它不可能便宜。我听说那儿的所有东西都很贵。本题考查宾语从句。根据答语中的cheap和expensive及句意可知答案为C项。

source.sourceFile: 宾语从句.md
source.analysisFile: 宾语从句.md

questions.prompt: What did Tom say to you just now,John? —He asked ______ .
options: A. why I am so happy today
B. what will I do for the weekend
C. who did I play football with after school
D. if I could go to the movies with him tonight
questions.analysis: 句意:——约翰,刚才汤姆对你说了什么?——他问我今晚是否可以和他一起去看电影。本题考查宾语从句。宾语从句应使用陈述句语序,排除B、C两项;主句的时态是一般过去时态,从句应该使用相应的过去时态,排除A项。故答案为D。

source.sourceFile: 宾语从句.md
source.analysisFile: 宾语从句.md

questions.prompt: Franklin told them all ______ to be in Britain again.
options: A. how happy was he
B. how happy he was
C. how was he happy
D. how he happy was
questions.analysis: 句意:富兰克林告诉他们所有人他再一次来到英国是多么高兴。本题考查宾语从句。宾语从句应用陈述句语序且形容词应与how紧挨着,故答案为B项。

questions.prompt: Hi,Tony!Do you know ______ ? —Yes,there is a coffee shop at the corner of the street.
options: A. when I can get a cup of coffee
B. when can I get a cup of coffee
C. where I can get a cup of coffee
D. where can I get a cup of coffee
questions.analysis:
句意:——嗨,Tony!你知道我在哪里可以买到一杯咖啡吗?——是的,在街道的拐角处有间咖啡屋。本题考查宾语从句的用法。根据答语可以排除A、B两项。宾语从句要用陈述句语序,故选C项。

questions.prompt: Did you notice ______ in her office? —Yes. She was going over our writing.
options: A. what was Miss Lin doing
B. what Miss Lin was doing
C. what does Miss Lin do
D. what Miss Lin does
questions.analysis: 句意:——你有没有注意到林老师在她的办公室里做什么?——注意到了。她在批阅我们的作文。此题考查宾语从句。宾语从句要用陈述句语序,排除A和C;根据答语可知应用过去进行时,因此选B。

source.analysisFile: 宾语从句.md

questions.prompt: Judy, could you tell me ______ the schoolbag? —Oh, yes. I bought it in a store on the Internet.
options: A. where did you buy
B. where will you buy
C. where you bought
D. where you will buy
questions.analysis: 句意:——朱迪,你能告诉我你在哪里买的书包吗?——哦,好的。我在网上的一家商店里买的。本题考查宾语从句。宾语从句采用陈述句语序,结合答语使用了一般过去时可知应选C。

source.analysisFile: 宾语从句.md

questions.prompt: Can you tell me ______ to London? —Sure.Next month.
options: A. when you will travel
B. when will you travel
C. when you travelled
D. when did you travel
questions.analysis: 本题考查宾语从句。宾语从句需要注意:语序、时态、连接词。选项中所有连接词都为when。宾语从句要用陈述句语序,故排除B和D两项。根据答语中Next month.可知,此处需要用一般将来时,故选A项。

B. when they are going to have
C. when did they have
D. when are they going to have
questions.analysis:
句意:——你知道他们什么时候开会吗?——明天上午。本题考查宾语从句。由Tomorrow morning.可知应用一般将来时,故可排除A、C两项。宾语从句的语序为陈述句语序,排除D项。故选B。

questions.prompt: We had a hot discussion about our summer trip just now. —Cool! Have you decided ______ ?
options: A. where did you go
B. where will you go
C. where you went
D. where you will go
questions.analysis: 句意:——刚刚我们就夏季旅行进行了一次激烈的讨论。——真棒!你们决定要去哪儿了吗?此题考查宾语从句用法。根据宾语从句要用陈述句语序的原则,排除A和B;再根据句意可以得知,夏季旅行还在讨论之中,所以肯定还没去,应用一般将来时,因此选D。

questions.prompt: Mike, do you know ______ ?Someone is looking for him. —Maybe he is in the library.
options: A. where is Tony
B. where was Tony
C. where Tony is
D. where Tony was
questions.analysis: 句意:——Mike,你知道Tony在哪儿吗?有人在找他呢。——他也许在图书馆吧。此题考查宾语从句用法。根据宾语从句要用陈述句语序的原则,排除A和B;根据答句中的is可以得知答语是一般现在时,因此要用一般现在时,因此选C。

options: A. when will you join in
B. when you will join in
C. when did you join in
D. when you joined in
questions.analysis: 句意:——Collin,你能告诉我你什么时候参加的国际物理奥林匹克竞赛吗?——当然了。在2018年7月。此题考查宾语从句用法。根据宾语从句要用陈述句语序的原则,排除A和C;根据答句中的2018可以得知说的是过去的事,因此要用一般过去时,因此选D。

questions.prompt: Sam, can you tell me ______ this math problem so fast? —Sure, let me show you.
options: A. how you will work out
B. how you worked out
C. how will you work out
D. how did you work out
questions.analysis: 句意:——Sam, 你能告诉我你是怎么这么快就做出这道数学题的吗?——当然可以,我来给你讲讲。此题考查宾语从句用法。答句当中没有明显的时间标志词,因此要分析句意,因为答句中说要给对方讲讲,所以可以判断出Sam已经做出来了,应用一般过去时,排除A和C,再根据语序排除D,因此选B。
